requirement_ref.quote: A top navigation bar containing the brand logo and links to core pages (Home, Products, Cart, Checkout). A dedicated shopping cart icon to display or navigate to user selections.

preconditions: STAGE is reachable and the home page loads
test_objective: Verify the top navigation bar shows links to all four core pages.

assertions.statement: A link to the Products page is present in the top navigation.

target.description: Products link, scoped to the top nav (the footer's Quick Links repeats the same link text — see requirement R-5 — so an unscoped match would be ambiguous)
target.name: Products

assertions.statement: A link to the Checkout page is present in the top navigation.

target.description: Checkout link, scoped to the top nav (also duplicated in the footer)
target.name: Checkout

assertions.statement: A link to the Cart is present in the top navigation.

target.description: Cart link, scoped to the top nav (also duplicated in the footer)
target.name: Cart
